records.text: PROPOSAL: adopt the 2026-08-27 board-trust audit remediation direction, for hugh's ratification. Six principles, each with its first enforcement site: (1) The projection never names an actor in waiting_on without an admissible closing act (fold.go projectCommitments). (2) Reviewed-and-rejected implementation lanes have a defined, truthful closure when their repair child supersedes them; no lane is left permanently reported. (3) Staleness is recorded, not refused, at every write boundary, matching merge.md:122; only retirement refuses (admission.go refuseDeadBases). (4) Artifact succession is content-aware: a merge republishes only artifacts whose covered subtree actually changed (cmd/gs/succession.go planSuccession), ending path-coverage republish churn. (5) Refiles are machine-readable — a replacing request names its predecessor in a declared field, preferably via the guarded reassignment — so chains are visible on the board. (6) A merged lane's worktree is removed at merge completion; worktree hygiene is part of closure (AGENTS.md step 6 gains an enforcement point). Implementation requests 673659b8 (closure) and the staleness-policy filing already rest on the audit assert 1216de75; items 4-6 will be filed as requests after this proposal is ratified or amended. Measured stakes in the assert: 37.8 durable events per merged change and 40% of commitments closing empty.

Worktree-discipline audit results and actions taken, completing the board-trust audit (assert 1216de75). 73 worktrees existed against ~25 live commitments; 60 served no live lane. Root cause is structural: AGENTS.md step 6 triggers cleanup only on merge, but 31 of 72 lane worktrees ended without one (cancelled, withdrawn, or superseded by a recut), so nothing ever prompted removal; recut chains left up to six checkouts per lane family.

ACTIONS TAKEN by planner today, under hugh's session directive: removed 19 worktrees independently re-verified clean with heads contained in main (including six under /private/tmp and one under /private/var/folders); pushed 8 local-only branches to origin so their heads survive ref loss (ui-notification-dropdown, github-proposal-commitment-chain, mcp-late-actor-recut, mcp-review-guard-recut, merge-all-live-succession, review-guard-authority-current, sealed-receipt-directional-resume, ui-event-addresses — the last two are recovery-lane deliverables under requests a3f62a52 and a246974b). Nothing dirty, active, or unmerged was touched.

DATA AT RISK — needs an ownership ruling, not deletion. Three worktrees hold work that exists on no ref anywhere: (1) gitseq-worktrees/canonical-authority-eventids — 242 uncommitted insertions across 16 files implementing ValidateAuthorityEventID plus SKILL.md and seven reference pages; zero board trace, zero commits on any ref; the branch head equals main so the ref preserves nothing. (2) gitseq-worktrees/security-gates — 212 uncommitted test lines, three named ciguard test functions on no commit anywhere. (3) gitseq-worktrees/custody-reconcile — mid-cherry-pick with two UU conflicts; only the partial resolution is unique. Per the one-writer rule these need their author identified and a decision to commit or discard; planner will not remove them.

REMAINING CLASSES: 31 clean worktrees on settled lanes are removable at any time with refs kept (list reproducible: any worktree whose branch has no non-settled commitment). 12 are active — note the duplicate-checkout hazard: three checkouts at b1daa567, two at 86af0f87 (one dirty with a test mutation), triplicate review-stale checkouts at c9280b32 already declared history by request #12614. Four worktrees exist solely to hold one-line test mutations and should be created and destroyed inside test runs. One refless commit edde4a62 sits under /private/tmp and will not survive a reboot; it is a near-duplicate mutation scratch of live head 86af0f87.

POLICY input for proposal c781f3f5 item 6: record body.worktree beside body.branch in promises; gs merge receipts name the lane worktree as removable; request retirement surfaces any worktree on the retired lane as unowned; refuse a second worktree at a live lane's head; a periodic gate flags worktrees whose branch has no non-settled commitment and heads reachable from no ref.

notes/2026-08-27-lane-identity.md at exact clean pushed head 6131249c6a6f86cbd8893bf30f2d582f88bbb274 on request/lane-identity-design, cut from main 02558e8d. First artifact at this path. Design note: associate work items with worktree/branch identity by content-addressed facts — (1) resident reverse index over Rests-On commit trailers, (2) gs worktree verb stamping worktree-local gitseq.request config with commit-hook trailer automation, (3) deterministic refs/gitseq/lanes/<request-hash> lane refs, (4) validated body.branch/body.worktree fields for display only. Refines proposal c781f3f5 items 5 and 6; the kernel learns nothing about git. Motivated by hugh's session direction and the worktree audit (assert eb4cd63d): 73 worktrees against ~25 live commitments, association recoverable only forensically. Documentation-only head; no code changes, no gates beyond the note itself.

PROPOSAL: adopt the decision recorded at notes/2026-08-27-lane-identity.md at commit 6131249c6a6f86cbd8893bf30f2d582f88bbb274 (artifact 953c3746). Lane identity is anchored in content-addressed facts — the Rests-On commit-trailer reverse index, worktree-local gitseq.request config stamped by a gs worktree verb, deterministic refs/gitseq/lanes/<request-hash> refs — with validated body.branch/body.worktree for display only; merge receipts and request retirements then compute the checkout that has become removable. This refines and sharpens items 5 and 6 of the standing audit-remediation proposal c781f3f5; the sequencing kernel learns nothing about git. For ratification by hugh. On ratification, planner files the implementation requests; the note's own head then proceeds to independent review and merge per the notes flow.
